name: Blue Planet Internet
summary: Early FreeBSD-based dialup + hosting ISP (bluep.com, c. 1996); defunct c. 2001.

events.details: Dialup, hosting, Tucows mirror; earliest Wayback capture Apr 1997 (bluep.com).

Defunct; substantial homepage through 1999, minimal placeholder by 2000-01, redirect from 2006. Blue Planet was demonstrably operational into late Jan 2003 and redirected to Eftel by Feb 2005, so death is c. 2003, not c. 2001.

refs.label: fully operating retail site (pricing/plans, join-now, news dated 26 Jan 2003) - contradicts a c. 2001 death
domain redirected into Eftel by 3 Feb 2005 (Lexicon/Eftel orbit); 2004-era capture of www.bluep.com is already a bare refresh stub

events.details: BLUE PLANET PTY LTD (ACN 160 489 074) was registered 24 Sep 2012, ~11 years after this ISP was defunct, and is an unrelated later name-collision entity.
